title: Bug check of the live game
description: Owner, 2026-11-11: there are bugs to check. Scope and source of the reports to be agreed with the owner; each bug found becomes a child issue.

title: Testers replay levels 40-150 on a phone (0.14.1)
description: The 0.14.1 gentle climb was judged with a simulated player (production/qa/sprint-15/stuck-sweep.md). The friends who reported the difficulty should replay levels 40-150 on a phone and say whether they still need boosters often. Live players report the game plays better now (owner, 2026-11-11).

title: Real-phone check of sharing (picture, challenge links)
description: Sprint 14 sharing was only tested with a faked share sheet in headless Chromium. On real phones, check: the daily/weekly picture is shared with the text (iOS Safari, Android Chrome), a challenge link sent from one phone opens the right card on another, and a pasted link shows the preview in WhatsApp or iMessage. Evidence: production/qa/evidence/sprint-14/.
